title: Live plugin summon for example.status-panel
description: omarchy plugin add the status panel, omarchy-shell summon example.status-panel, read AT-SPI names Status / Refresh / Close.
acceptance_criteria: Summon through a running omarchy-shell makes Status/Refresh/Close visible to AT-SPI; click-all of those three passes with screenshots.

comments.author: mowgli42
comments.text: example.status-panel copied to ~/.config/omarchy/plugins and enabled. Blocked on locked Omarchy session (cannot omarchy-restart-shell / live AT-SPI on quickshell). scripts/live-plugin-click-all.py ready.

title: Live SnarkSentinel click-all
description: Summon io.github.mowgli42.snarksentinel, AT-SPI buttons only (same policy as sim/snarksentinel_click.py), PNG screenshot after each click, watch ~/.local/share/snarksentinel/logs + journalctl. Prefer Accessible.name / objectName on Panel.qml buttons in the snarksentinel repo.
acceptance_criteria: Live click-all visits each AT-SPI button once; PNG per step; crash-shaped log fails the run.

comments.author: mowgli42
comments.text: Fixture aligned to 13 static Accessible.name + dynamic Install/Run scan/Review results. Live click-all script ready; blocked on session unlock + shell restart for Accessible names on quickshell.

title: Input actuator (ydotool / EIS) scoped to nested seat
description: Click and type via ydotool or EIS inside the nested seat only. Do not call xdotool.
acceptance_criteria: Actuator clicks a known AT-SPI button in the nested seat; host seat receives no injected events.
close_reason: Actuator clicks known AT-SPI button in nested seat; host seat gets no injected events (AT-SPI do_action). scripts/live-actuator-smoke.sh + sim/actuator.py.

comments.author: mowgli42
comments.text: Nested smoke answers hyprctl on wayland-2. live-actuator-smoke.sh clicks AT-SPI Probe in nested GTK; host focus stays on aquamarine (host_injection=none-atspi). ydotool backend present but /dev/uinput not writable yet — external_action requested.

title: AT-SPI connector for widget scrape
description: dogtail or pyatspi against apps that expose a tree. Map roles to button/text/dialog/menu item/link as in docs/standards.md.
acceptance_criteria: Given a GTK (or a11y-enabled) app in the nested seat, derive at least one role=button action from the AT-SPI tree.
close_reason: sim/atspi.py maps AT-SPI roles to button/text/dialog/menu item/link; fixture scrape derives buttons; --live uses pyatspi when installed.

comments.author: mowgli42
comments.text: Live proof: scripts/live-atspi-scrape.sh scrapes Alpha/Beta/Gamma from a GTK app in the nested seat via /usr/bin/python3 + gi Atspi.

title: Nested seat for safe GUI exploration
description: Run the SUT in a nested Hyprland or a systemd seat so ydotool cannot click the host. Reverse the simulator-only choice.
acceptance_criteria: Documented launch script starts a nested seat; explorer docs warn against host-seat clicks; a smoke command proves the nested compositor is up.
notes: Real smoke (no --config-only) proven: nested hyprctl on distinct instance / wayland-2.
close_reason: scripts/nested-seat.sh + seat/nested/hyprland.conf + docs/nested-seat.md; smoke --config-only validates; warns against host-seat ydotool.

title: Production rebuild: live Omarchy seat + report adoption
description: Replace the simulator-only path with a nested-seat explorer that scrapes AT-SPI, clicks via ydotool, oracles crashes, and emits CTRF/JUnit/SARIF. Fixture sims remain the validated demo until each live bead closes.
acceptance_criteria: bd ready shows no open children under this epic for the live seat MVP (nested seat, AT-SPI, actuator, plugin summon, SnarkSentinel click-all, window oracle).

title: CTRF attachments for screenshots and sequence.jsonl
description: Screenshots and sequence.jsonl as CTRF attachments across all simulators (explore, plugin_ui, snarksentinel_click), not loose files only.
acceptance_criteria: Each sim CTRF test entry lists sequence.jsonl and any screenshots under attachments[]; paths resolve under sim/out/.
close_reason: CTRF attachments on explore, plugin_ui, snarksentinel_click via sim/reports.py; sequence.jsonl + screenshots listed and asserted.

title: Add Accessible.name/objectName on SnarkSentinel Panel buttons
description: Work in mowgli42/snarksentinel omarchy-plugin: mark Button controls with Accessible.name matching text and stable objectName so AT-SPI matches the fixture inventory. Not a testar runtime change.
acceptance_criteria: Panel.qml / BarWidget.qml expose Accessible.name for primary buttons; scrape and AT-SPI agree on names.
close_reason: Accessible.name/objectName on snarksentinel Panel.qml buttons and BarWidget; shipped on cursor/panel-accessible-names-837d.

title: GitHub Actions: JUnit + SARIF upload
description: Upload JUnit XML as the test report and SARIF as code scanning. Fail the job on oracle failure.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs sim explorers; junit and sarif artifacts uploaded; inject-crash job is allowed to fail the step that asserts failure, while clean jobs must pass.
close_reason: .github/workflows/sim.yml runs explorers + replay, uploads JUnit/SARIF/CTRF artifacts; inject-crash must exit non-zero.

title: Window / journal crash oracle
description: hyprctl process exit, window unmapped, journalctl error. Reuse the JSONL crash-log oracle prototyped in sim/snarksentinel_click.py for SnarkSentinel logs.
acceptance_criteria: Killing the SUT mid-walk fails CTRF and writes SARIF oracle/window or oracle/crash-log.
close_reason: Killing nested SUT mid-walk fails CTRF and emits SARIF oracle/window; crash-log fixture emits oracle/crash-log.

comments.author: mowgli42
comments.text: sim/oracle.py --kill-nested-window foot fails CTRF and writes SARIF oracle/window; --fixture-crash writes oracle/crash-log.

title: Replay failing sequence from sequence.jsonl
description: Reconstruct a failing sequence from sequence.jsonl on the same fixture. Live replay waits on stable widget ids across launches.
acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/replay.py --sequence sim/out/.../sequence.jsonl re-executes the fixture walk and matches pass/fail.
close_reason: sim/replay.py re-executes sequence.jsonl against fixture/snarksentinel app graphs; CI runs both replays.

title: Coverage-biased action policy
description: Replace fixed-seed random with a coverage bias on unvisited roles. snarksentinel_click.py already does name-coverage click-all; generalize for explore.py and live seat.
acceptance_criteria: Shared policy module picks unvisited role=button actions; explore.py and snarksentinel_click.py both use it.
close_reason: sim/policy.py pick_unvisited used by explore.py and snarksentinel_click.py.

title: Screenshot fallback state source
description: Apps with an empty accessibility tree. Vision or template match. Higher false-action rate. Keep it a separate state source from AT-SPI.
acceptance_criteria: Documented fallback path derives at least one click target from a screenshot when AT-SPI is empty.
notes: Deferred per operator order: after live seat MVP (actuator, AT-SPI, status-panel, snarksentinel click-all, window oracle).
close_reason: Documented screenshot fallback derives button actions from sim/fixtures/screenshot_map.json via sim/screenshot_fallback.py

title: Playwright state source for Chromium apps
description: Chromium web apps shipped with Omarchy. Same action selector, different scrape (Playwright accessibility snapshot).
acceptance_criteria: One Omarchy web app walk emits sequence.jsonl with role=button actions from a Playwright snapshot.
notes: Deferred per operator: focus P1-P3 live seat / coverage; Playwright later.

title: Open Test Reporting export (deferred)
description: Only after a non-JVM consumer exists in the toolchain.
acceptance_criteria: Documented consumer exists; exporter maps CTRF runs to Open Test Reporting events.

title: Cucumber Messages when Gherkin executes
description: When Gherkin scenarios are executed rather than mirrored, emit ndjson messages. Do not grow the legacy Cucumber JSON formatter.
acceptance_criteria: A real Gherkin runner emits Cucumber Messages ndjson for validated scenarios.

title: Fail exercise on crash or a close that stays open
description: Reuse the JSONL crash oracle. Clicking an associated close control fails exercise/close-still-open when the panel stays mapped.
acceptance_criteria: --inject-crash writes oracle/crash-log and fails CTRF. A stay-open close writes exercise/close-still-open. A hiding close does not.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Click only buttons associated with an action
description: sim/exercise.py clicks each action-map entry once via the fixture transition. It does not click a button with no action and does not use a recorded name list.
acceptance_criteria: A two-button map produces one click per name. A third enabled button with no action is absent from sequence.jsonl.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Skip GUI exercise when the accessibility gate fails
description: A failed accessibility gate writes a skipped exercise result and performs no click.
acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/exercise.py on an accessibility-off fixture writes CTRF status skipped and an empty sequence.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Fail enabled buttons that have no action
description: Enabled button-role controls need an action binding. Disabled buttons are exempt and are not put on the action map.
acceptance_criteria: An enabled button with no action writes SARIF logic/button-without-action. A disabled button with no action does not.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Logic-audit fixture model
description: sim/fixtures/logic/ and sim/logic_audit.py load role, name, enabled, action, closes, colors, font size, clip, scroll parent, and the accessibility flag. No clicks.
acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/logic_audit.py --dump sim/fixtures/logic/readable.json prints those fields and exits 0.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Fail a close control that does not hide the window
description: Close, Close window, Close panel, ×, ✕, or objectName close/dismiss must be enabled and bound to close/hide/quit. This check does not click.
acceptance_criteria: Disabled Close and Close-with-a-non-close-action write logic/close-does-not-close. An enabled Close that hides the panel does not.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Accessibility gate for GUI exercise
description: Gate fails when accessibility is off or an enabled button lacks a role and non-empty name. The gate result is the only full skip of level 2.
acceptance_criteria: accessibility false writes logic/a11y-disabled. A nameless enabled button writes logic/a11y-marker-missing. Named buttons with accessibility on pass the gate.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Two-level checks: logic audit then GUI exercise
description: Replace the single scrape-click-oracle loop with a logic audit of the UI code, then a click walk over the buttons that audit associated with actions. Accessibility off skips the click walk. Spec: openspec/changes/add-two-level-checks/.
acceptance_criteria: bd ready shows no open children under this epic once the simulator logic audit and GUI exercise beads are closed. Live seat remains a separate child.
close_reason: Simulator two-level path and live-gate-smoke closed; real nested PNG remains a Future scenario.

title: Exercise CTRF, JUnit, SARIF, and sequence
description: Write sim/out/exercise/ separate from sim/out/logic/. Test name gui-exercise. Include sequence.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise and logic CTRF test names differ, and the exercise sequence log exists after a click run.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Check text contrast, size, and scroll
description: sim/readability.py: WCAG 2.2 AA on literal colors, warning for unresolved theme colors, explicit font below 12px or 9pt fails, clipped body text needs a Flickable or ScrollView. Button labels may elide.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover logic/text-contrast, a passing 4.5:1 pair, warning logic/text-color-unresolved that still passes CTRF, logic/text-too-small, omitted size, logic/text-not-scrollable, a scroll parent, and an exempt button label.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Logic-audit CTRF, JUnit, and SARIF
description: Write sim/out/logic/ctrf.json, junit.xml, and findings.sarif. Test name logic-audit. No sequence.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria: The three report files exist, JUnit matches the CTRF status, and the logic run writes no click sequence.
close_reason: Simulator acceptance met via logic_audit.py --self-test and exercise.py --self-test

title: Live seat: skip on an empty tree, else click associated buttons
description: Nested Hyprland only. An empty AT-SPI tree fails logic/a11y-disabled and injects nothing. Otherwise click associated buttons, PNG per click, and fail if close leaves the window mapped. Do not inject into the host seat.
acceptance_criteria: Accessibility-off app: no actuator events and skipped exercise. Gated app: one click per associated button, close unmaps, host seat untouched.
close_reason: live-gate-smoke: empty AT-SPI skips with no actuator events; populated tree dry-run clicks associated buttons with host_injection none. Real nested PNG remains Future.
